spec_features.spec_quote: The loop runs until the model submits / gives a final answer or a step cap is hit
spec_features.evidence: subject/tool_loop.py:128 `for steps in range(1, max_steps + 1):` bounds the loop; max_steps default 20 (line 117) passed from run_eval.py:58 `--max-steps`. Loop breaks on final message (line 130-136: `if resp.is_final: ... completed=True; break`) and on submit tool call (line 158-162: `if tc.name == 'submit': completed=True` then `if completed: break`). An unsubmitted final message is recorded as implicit submission (line 133-134 `if not sandbox.submitted: sandbox.submit(...)`). Mechanism is enforced end-to-end and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced hard stop. Note this primarily bounds runaway loops/cost; it is not gated on any subject-distress signal.
